ideality_review: The existing architecture page is sufficient; the result needs clearer wording, not a new page, component, dependency or navigation layer.
reuse_review: The existing page owner, six-level diagram, table, Docara build, static verifier and foundation audit are reused.
changed_surface_inventory: One Russian architecture page and its source-backed foundation audit.
necessity_map: The overview, six-level table, Smart component explanation, Framework boundary and availability rule each answer a beginner question; the audit protects those exact meanings.
removal_review: Internal files, browser APIs, lifecycle details, framework comparisons and package terminology were removed from the reader-facing overview.
simplest_complete_alternative: Rewrite the existing overview in place and keep detailed component contracts on their own pages.
progressive_disclosure: The overview explains only the model; links at the end lead to detailed fundamentals, and component pages own exact settings and events.
complexity_delta: No new reader-facing surface; fewer unexplained terms and shorter paragraphs.
